questionSnapshot.question: What type of animal is Timon in The Lion King?

notes: q67 requests Pumbaa’s species, not Timon’s. Animal identifications require separate facts. Checked all four final options, mobile wording, clue fairness, category, editorial difficulty and theatrical/character/park scope. Full topic digests and additional all-shard searches were used for distinctness; context questions are not approved by this review.

verification.context: English-language Disney character naming; original theatrical feature where a film is named. What type of animal is Timon in The Lion King?

premise.reason: Timon is a meerkat; a meerkat belongs to the mongoose family.

sources.locator: Opening three synopsis paragraphs: Scar’s murder and usurpation; Mufasa as king/father; Pumbaa as warthog; Timon as meerkat; Rafiki as guiding shaman.
Taxonomy header and ABOUT opening: Suricata suricatta, Herpestidae; member of mongoose family, with Timon identified as a meerkat.

challenge.notes: Original Mongoose option was defensible as the broader family description, so it was replaced. Challenged the final alternatives for the same nesting problem: prairie dog, otter and weasel do not contain meerkat as a subgroup.

options.reason: Both the film synopsis and zoo reference identify Timon as a meerkat.
